Overview

Næstved is a city in Zealand with a population of 44,000. A historic market town in southern Zealand, known for its medieval monastery, harbor, and cultural events. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
